name: relay
description: Main agent dispatches tasks to persistent worker sessions via CLI (Claude Code, Codex or OpenCode per role); workers report back as compact, lossless-on-essentials relay packets.

defaultBackend.title: Default backend
defaultBackend.description: Worker CLI for roles that name none: claude, codex or opencode.

claudeBin.title: Claude executable
claudeBin.description: Executable used to start claude workers (no shell): a name, a full path, or a JSON list of program and leading arguments.

codexBin.title: Codex executable
codexBin.description: Executable used to start codex workers (no shell). On Windows the npm 'codex' is a .cmd starter: give the full path to codex.exe.

codexSandbox.title: Codex sandbox
codexSandbox.description: OS sandbox for codex workers. workspace-write: writes only in its folder, no network. read-only: no writes.

opencodeBin.title: OpenCode executable
opencodeBin.description: Executable used to start opencode workers (no shell); a full path to opencode.exe on Windows.

opencodeStandalone.title: OpenCode standalone
opencodeStandalone.description: Run each opencode worker with its own server (--standalone), so stopping it at the timeout also stops its work.

permissionMode.title: Worker permission mode
permissionMode.description: Permission mode passed to worker sessions.

workerModel.title: Worker model
workerModel.description: Default model for workers; empty uses the CLI default. Roles may override it.

workerEffort.title: Worker effort
workerEffort.description: Default effort for workers; roles may override it.

maxBudgetUsd.title: Budget per run (USD)
maxBudgetUsd.description: Upper cost limit for one worker run; 0 means no limit.

maxParallel.title: Parallel workers
maxParallel.description: How many workers run at once; further tasks wait in the queue.

runTimeoutMin.title: Timeout per run (minutes)
runTimeoutMin.description: A worker still running after this is stopped and reported as failed or partial; 0 means no timeout.

maxTokensPerRun.title: Token limit per run
maxTokensPerRun.description: codex and opencode only: stop a run once its input plus output tokens pass this (may overshoot by one turn); 0 means no limit.

allowedTools.title: Allowed tools
allowedTools.description: Comma-separated tool rules workers may use without asking, e.g. Read, Grep, Bash(git status:*). Roles may override it.

disallowedTools.title: Disallowed tools
disallowedTools.description: Comma-separated tool rules workers may never use, e.g. Bash(git push:*), WebFetch. Roles may override it.

enforceOwns.title: Enforce ownership
enforceOwns.description: Block Edit, Write and NotebookEdit in a claude worker outside the paths its role owns (shell writes are not covered).

writeCheck.title: Write check
writeCheck.description: report: compare git before and after each run, for every backend, and report writes outside owns. off: no check.

isolation.title: Default isolation
isolation.description: shared: roles work in the project folder. worktree: each role in its own git worktree on branch relay/<role>, never merged by relay.

notifyMode.title: Packet delivery
notifyMode.description: prompt: wakes the main agent with a turn of its own. note: added silently, read at the next turn. toast: only a toast, packets via worker_status.

packetDetail.title: Packet detail
packetDetail.description: full: every field. lean: what needs action; facts, risks and next steps on demand.

fallbackCompress.title: Fallback compression
fallbackCompress.description: Build a packet with the fallback model when a worker forgot to emit one.

fallbackModel.title: Fallback compressor model
fallbackModel.description: Claude model that builds a relay packet when a worker forgot to emit one (fallback backend claude).

fallbackBackend.title: Fallback compressor backend
fallbackBackend.description: Who builds a missing packet: claude (the fallback model), ollama (the ollama model, as a local process) or off.

ollamaModel.title: Ollama model
ollamaModel.description: Model for the ollama fallback compressor, e.g. qwen3:8b. Empty works like off. Cloud models (…:cloud) send the answer off the machine.

ollamaBin.title: Ollama executable
ollamaBin.description: Executable for the ollama fallback compressor (no shell).

relayDir.title: Relay folder
relayDir.description: Project folder for run files (under runs/) and the default roles file.

rolesFile.title: Roles file
rolesFile.description: JSON file with predefined roles (brief, owns, model, effort, allowedTools, disallowedTools, backend, isolation).

gitignore.title: Ignore run files in git
gitignore.description: Add <relay folder>/runs/, queue.json, tmp/ and worktrees/ to .gitignore in git projects; the roles file stays versioned.

keepRuns.title: Runs kept per role
keepRuns.description: Run files rotate through this many slots per role; 0 keeps every run.
